FEAR.SHOCK_01_20: Badly startled: may only take a single Half Action in his next Turn, but afterwards he may act normally.
FEAR.SHOCK_21_40: Fear grips the character and he begins to shake and tremble. He is at a –10 penalty on all Tests for the rest of the encounter unless he can recover his wits (snap out of it with a Willpower Test at the beginning of his next Turn).
FEAR.SHOCK_41_60: Reeling with shock, the character backs away from the thing that confronts them. The character cannot willingly approach the object of his fear, but may otherwise act normally, with a –10 penalty on all Tests until the end of the encounter. Gains 1 Insanity Point.
FEAR.SHOCK_61_80: The character is frozen by terror. The character may make no Actions until he snaps out of it. After snapping out of it, the character will make all Tests with a –10 penalty for the rest of the encounter. Gains 1d5 Insanity Points.
FEAR.SHOCK_81_100: Panic grips the character. He must flee the source of his fear, if able, as fast as he can, and if prevented from doing so, he may only take Half Actions and is at a –20 penalty to all Tests. Gains 1d5 Insanity Points. Once away from the danger, he must successfully snap out of it to regain control.
FEAR.SHOCK_101_120: Fainting dead away, the character keels over and remains unconscious for 1d5 Rounds. Once he regains consciousness, he is still shaken and takes all Tests with a –10 penalty until the end of the encounter. Gains 1d5 Insanity Points.
FEAR.SHOCK_121_130: Totally overcome, the character screams and vomits uncontrollably for 1d5 Rounds. During this time he is helpless, may do nothing and drop anything he is holding. Afterwards, until the end of the encounter, the character may only take a single Half Action each Turn until he can rest. Gains 1d5 Insanity Points.
FEAR.SHOCK_131_140: The character laughs hysterically and randomly attacks anything near him in a manic frenzy, firing wildly or using whatever weapon he has to hand. This effect lasts until the character snaps out of it, or until he is knocked unconscious. Gains 1d5 Insanity Points.
FEAR.SHOCK_141_160: The character crumples to the ground for 1d5+1 Rounds sobbing, babbling, and tearing at his own flesh, and may do nothing. Even after he returns to his senses, he is a complete mess and at a –20 penalty on all Tests until the end of the encounter. Gains 1d5+1 Insanity Points.
FEAR.SHOCK_161_170: The character’s mind snaps and he becomes catatonic for 1d5 hours and may not be roused. Gains 1d10 Insanity Points.
FEAR.SHOCK_171_PLUS: The character is so affected that he begins to see strange and terrible visions as his hold on reality shatters. He suffers the effects of “acute hallucinations” for 2d10 Rounds. After the hallucinations fade, the character will make all Tests with a –20 penalty while the encounter lasts. Gains 2d10 Insanity Points and takes 1d10 points of permanent Willpower damage.
FEAR.NONCOMBAT_FAILURE: The character becomes unnerved and suffers a –10 penalty to any Skill or Test that requires concentration while he remains in the vicinity of the object of his Fear.
FEAR.NONCOMBAT_INSANITY: Failed by 30 or more: gains +1d5 Insanity Points.

CREATOR.CAREER_HINT: There are no special restrictions on careers (Core Rulebook p24); star-marked careers are commonly appropriate for your Home World (Table 1-1, p18).

SHIP_COMBAT.FIRE_TOOLTIP: Gunner BS test → hits → void shields → damage → criticals
SHIP_COMBAT.NOT_A_SALVO_WEAPON: Not a salvo weapon: only macrobatteries and lances fire in a salvo — torpedo tubes, nova cannon and landing bays need an Extended Action (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_COMBAT.OUT_OF_RANGE: Out of range: the target is beyond twice the weapon's range (Core Rulebook p219-220).

SHIP_COMBAT.CRIPPLED_EFFECTS: −10 Manoeuvrability and Detection, Speed halved, weapon Strength halved (round up) — Core Rulebook p221
SHIP_COMBAT.CRIPPLED_NOW: The target is now Crippled (0 Hull Integrity).
SHIP_COMBAT.REPAIR_TOOLTIP: Difficult (−10) Tech-Use: repairs one unpowered, damaged, or depressurised component (1d5 turns, −1 per degree, min 1) — Core Rulebook p218

SHIP_ACTION.CREW_FALLBACK: Rolled by the ship's crew quality (no helmsman assigned) — Core Rulebook p214, Table 8-9
SHIP_ACTION.PERFORMER_UNRESOLVED: {actor} owns neither "{skill}" nor its bare form — resolve the training first (Core Rulebook p75).
SHIP_ACTION.UNKNOWN_TEST: "{action}" carries no resolvable printed test ("{test}") — extend the ship-action vocabulary.
SHIP_ACTION.UNKNOWN_DIFFICULTY: "{action}" prints an unrecognized difficulty ("{difficulty}") — fix the ship-action item.
SHIP_ACTION.DEFAULT_MANOEUVRE: The ship moves directly forward by its full or half Speed value, then may turn — free, no test. On a failed Manoeuvre the ship performs exactly this — Core Rulebook p213.
SHIP_ACTION.DEFAULT_MANOEUVRE_SILENT_RUN: On Silent Running: Speed halved, and the default Manoeuvre requires an Ordinary (+10) Pilot (Space Craft)+ Manoeuvrability Test; a failure betrays the ship's position — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.FACING_NOTE: Facing: this hull may turn up to {degrees} degrees — Core Rulebook p213
SHIP_ACTION.SILENT_RUNNING_STEP: Silent Running: related tests advance one difficulty step — Core Rulebook p218
SHIP_ACTION.DISENGAGE_DISTANCE_PROMPT: Enter the current distance to the nearest enemy ship in VUs (Disengage may not be performed within 8 VUs of an enemy — Core Rulebook p214):
SHIP_ACTION.DISENGAGE_WITHIN_8: "{ship}" is within 8 VUs of an enemy — Disengage may not be performed (Core Rulebook p214).
SHIP_ACTION.DISENGAGE_OPPOSED_NOTE: Opposed test: the enemy side makes its Challenging (+0) Detection+Scrutiny Test manually, for ships within 20 VUs — Core Rulebook pp214-215
SHIP_ACTION.DISENGAGE_NO_FIRE: Whether the test succeeds or fails, the ship may not fire any weapons this turn — Core Rulebook p215
SHIP_ACTION.DISENGAGE_NO_REENGAGE: The ship has disengaged: it may not re-engage unless the GM specifically allows, and Disengage cannot initiate a Stern Chase — Core Rulebook p215
SHIP_ACTION.EVASIVE_SET: Evasive Manoeuvres: −10 to all shooting directed against the ship until the beginning of its next turn — Core Rulebook p215
SHIP_ACTION.HEADING_SET: Come to New Heading: −20 to Ballistic Skill tests to fire weapons this turn — Core Rulebook p214
SHIP_ACTION.ROW_REQUIRES_PERFORMER: "{action}" is performed by an assigned Explorer — the crew quality cannot stand in for this test (Core Rulebook pp217-218).
SHIP_ACTION.HOLD_FAST_AUTHORITY: {actor} does not own Air of Authority — Hold Fast! requires it (or a similar Talent at the GM's discretion, Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.SKILL_PROMPT: "{action}" — which of the printed skills does the character use?
SHIP_ACTION.INTERACTION_UNOWNED: {actor} can attempt none of the Interaction skills (Core Rulebook p293 — advanced ones, such as Blather, cannot be attempted untrained; Core Rulebook p74).
SHIP_ACTION.HAIL_PROMPT: Hail the Enemy — which Interaction skill does the character hail with? (the exact details are the GM's, Core Rulebook p217)
SHIP_ACTION.HAIL_NOTE: Hail the Enemy: the interaction test's exact details are left to the GM (Core Rulebook p217; Interaction Skills, p293).
SHIP_ACTION.AUGURY_RANGE_NOTE: Active Augury: scan radius {range} VU (base 20 + 5 per degree) — the GM reveals the essentials: celestial bodies, phenomena and ships (Core Rulebook p216).
SHIP_ACTION.AUGURY_SILENT_DETECTED: Silent Running detected: {ship} runs silent within the scan — Core Rulebook p216.
SHIP_ACTION.FOCUSED_REVEALED: Focused Augury on {target}: {count} components revealed ({names}) — Core Rulebook p217; critical-hit component picks are now gated to these.
SHIP_ACTION.AID_PROMPT: Which system is the machine spirit aiding this turn? (Core Rulebook p216)
SHIP_ACTION.AID_NOTE: Aid the Machine Spirit: +{value} {stat} for the remainder of the turn — Core Rulebook p216.
SHIP_ACTION.DISINFORMATION_NOTE: Disinformation: raise the crew's Morale by 1d5 for every degree of success ({degrees} degrees) for the duration of the combat — apply to the Morale track manually (Core Rulebook p216).
SHIP_ACTION.FLANK_SPEED_NOTE: Flank Speed: +{vus} VU of movement this turn — Core Rulebook p217.
SHIP_ACTION.FLANK_SPEED_CRIPPLED: The engines strained too hard ({degrees} degrees past a failure): the ship immediately suffers the Engines Crippled critical — "Ship Critical — Engines Crippled (6)" (Core Rulebook p217).
SHIP_ACTION.MANUAL_RANGE_HIT_RUN: Hit and Run: the raid reaches a target within 5 VUs — confirm the range manually (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_OPPOSED_NOTE: Opposed Ordinary (+10) Command Test against the enemy commander — resolve MANUALLY (Core Rulebook p218): +10 per full 10 points of Crew Population difference, +10 per full 10 points of Hull Integrity difference, and +10 per Turret Rating point to that ship's side (Core Rulebook p215/p220).
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_SHOT_DOWN: Failed by {degrees} degrees: the boarding craft is shot down — the character survives stranded or is killed at the GM's discretion (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_RETURN: Failed: the character is forced to return to his ship (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_RAID_LOST: The raiders were driven back — the raid retreats without effects (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_PROMPT: The opposed Ordinary (+10) Command Test against the enemy commander has been resolved manually (Core Rulebook p218):
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_DEGREES_PROMPT: Degrees of success on the opposed Command Test (1 point of Hull Integrity damage per degree):
SHIP_ACTION.CRITICAL_PICK_TITLE: Hit and Run — pick a critical
SHIP_ACTION.CRITICAL_PICK_PROMPT: Rolled 1d5 on the Ship Critical chart twice — select the result to apply (Core Rulebook p218):
SHIP_ACTION.HIT_RUN_APPLIED: Hit and Run on {target}: Hull Integrity −{degrees} (crew losses follow as normal, Core Rulebook p221); pick the sabotage component from the target.
SHIP_ACTION.JAM_NOTE: Jam Communications: the target cannot use vox-transmitters or other non-psychic technologies to communicate (Psychic communicators, such as an Astropath, are unaffected); the jam reaches {range} VU (+1 per degree) — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.LOCK_ON_TARGET_PROMPT: Which Weapon Component does the Ballistic Skill bonus name this turn?
SHIP_ACTION.LOCK_ON_TARGET_NOTE: Lock on Target: +{value} Ballistic Skill firing {weapon} this turn — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.REPEL_BOARDERS_NOTE: Prepare to Repel Boarders!: +{value} to opposed Command Tests against enemy boarders — maintained (persistent) while the character keeps rallying the defenders — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.BACKS_PROMPT: Which action gains the +5 this turn? (Core Rulebook p218)
SHIP_ACTION.BACKS_BS: A Ballistic Skill Test to fire a Weapon Component
SHIP_ACTION.BACKS_FIRE: An attempt to put out a fire
SHIP_ACTION.BACKS_WEAPON_PROMPT: Which Weapon Component is being fired? (+5 to its Ballistic Skill Test)
SHIP_ACTION.BACKS_NOTE: Put Your Backs Into It!: +5 to {targets} this turn ({count} aided) — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.BACKS_FIRE_MANUAL: Fire-fighting has no automatic roll here: apply the +5 to the GM's manual fire-fighting attempt (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.HOLD_FAST_NOTE: Hold Fast!: {cancelled} of the previous turn's {losses} points of Morale damage cancelled (1 + 1 per degree of success, minimum 1) — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.HOLD_FAST_NONE: Hold Fast!: no Morale damage was suffered during the previous turn, so nothing is cancelled (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_ACTION.TRIAGE_NOTE: Triage: {cancelled} of the previous turn's {losses} points of Crew Population damage cancelled (1 + 1 per degree of success, minimum 1) — Core Rulebook p218.
SHIP_ACTION.TRIAGE_NONE: Triage: no Crew Population damage was suffered during the previous Turn, so nothing is cancelled (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_COMBAT.REPAIR_INELIGIBLE: "{component}" cannot be Emergency Repaired (destroyed components need a forge world or stardock) — Core Rulebook p218/p224
SHIP_COMBAT.COMPONENT_NONFUNCTIONAL: "{weapon}" is not functional (damaged/destroyed components cannot fire) — Core Rulebook p223
SHIP_COMBAT.STATE_HINT: Component condition (Core Rulebook p223: intact / unpowered / damaged / destroyed)
SHIP_COMBAT.HELMSMAN_HINT: The Explorer performing the combined test: their Pilot (Space Craft) + the ship's Manoeuvrability (Core Rulebook p212). With none picked the ship's crew-quality skill stands in (Core Rulebook Table 8-9).
SHIP_COMBAT.TEST_NOTE_ONLY: Manual machinery (GM resolved — Core Rulebook p215)
SHIP_COMBAT.NO_SHIP_ACTIONS: The starship-actions compendium pack is not installed — no ship-action chips available.
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_EXPIRY: Expires at the ship's next Strategic Turn
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_PERSISTENT: Persistent: lasts until the acting character stops maintaining it (Core Rulebook p218)
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_BACKS_INTO_IT_OWN: Put Your Backs Into It! (+5, named action) — Core Rulebook p218
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_AID_MACHINE_SPIRIT: Aid the Machine Spirit: +{value} {stat} — Core Rulebook p216
SHIP_COMBAT.SILENT_RUNNING_HINT: Toggle Silent Running (Core Rulebook p218): Speed halved, related tests one step harder — FIRING immediately reveals the ship.
SHIP_COMBAT.SILENT_RUNNING_ON: Silent Running engaged: Speed halved, all related tests one step harder; firing immediately reveals the ship (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_COMBAT.CRITICAL_SELECT: Select the affected component (the attacker chooses among components he knows of, Core Rulebook p221):
SHIP_COMBAT.NO_TARGET: No target ship selected (target a starship in Foundry first).
SHIP_COMBAT.SALVO_CARD_HINT: Salvo resolution per Core Rulebook pp220-221.
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_EVASIVE_OWN: Evasive Manoeuvres (own fire) — Core Rulebook p215
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_EVASIVE_TARGET: Target: Evasive Manoeuvres — Core Rulebook p215
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_LOCK_ON_TARGET_OWN: Lock on Target (named component) — Core Rulebook p217
SHIP_COMBAT.TURN_FLAG_COME_TO_NEW_HEADIN: Come to New Heading (fire this turn) — Core Rulebook p214
SHIP_COMBAT.TURRET_RATING_ROW: Target's Turret Rating ({rating}) — Core Rulebook p220
SHIP_COMBAT.COMPONENTS_NOT_REVEALED: No Components are revealed on {target} — Focused Augury (Core Rulebook p217) fills the revealed set; component picks stay gated to it.
SHIP_COMBAT.SILENT_RUNNING_REVEALED: Firing revealed the ship — Silent Running is broken (Core Rulebook p218).
SHIP_COMBAT.BOARDED_NO_SHOOTING: The ship is boarded: neither ship can take Shooting Actions (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_COMBAT.BOARDED_NO_MANOEUVRE: The ship is boarded: neither ship can take Manoeuvre Actions (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.GIVES_UP_SHOOTING: The ramming/boarding attempt gives up the ship's Shooting Action this turn (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.ALREADY_FIRED: The ship has already fired this turn — it cannot ram or board now (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.OUT_OF_RANGE: The attempt fails its distance check: {row} requires the enemy within 1 VU (recorded {distance} VU) — Core Rulebook p215.
SHIP_BOARDING.DISTANCE_PROMPT: Recorded distance to {target} in VUs (the book allows the attempt only within 1 VU — Core Rulebook p215; the bow facing stays a GM check):
SHIP_BOARDING.NOT_BOARDED: No boarding lock is in force — break-free and rout only run during a boarding action (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.RAM_UNKNOWN_HULL_CLASS: "{hullClass}" carries no printed ramming die — map the hull class first (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.PARTNER_UNRESOLVED: The boarded partner ship ({uuid}) could not be resolved — clear its boarding state manually.
SHIP_BOARDING.LOCK_NOTE: The ships are locked: NEITHER can take Manoeuvre or Shooting Actions (extended actions stay legal); both drop to last in initiative (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.OPPOSED_COMMAND_NOTE: Each boarding turn the leaders roll an OPPOSED Command Test (resolved manually — the GM compares); the winner's per-degree pick: 1d5 Crew Population + 1d5 Morale, or 1 Hull Integrity (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.COMMAND_BONUS_ROWS: Opposed Command rows (computed both directions — Core Rulebook p215/p218/p220)
SHIP_BOARDING.COMMAND_BONUS_POPULATION: +10 per full 10 points of Crew Population difference
SHIP_BOARDING.COMMAND_BONUS_HULL: +10 per full 10 points of Hull Integrity difference
SHIP_BOARDING.COMBINED_FAILED: The combined test failed — no ram/lock (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.BREAK_FREE_CLEARED: The ship broke free — the lock is cleared on BOTH ships (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.BREAK_FREE_PENALTY: Failed break-free: −20 on the ship's subsequent opposed Command Test (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.BREAK_FREE_HINT: Break free: Hard (−20) Pilot (Space Craft) + Manoeuvrability at the START of the ship's turn (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.IGNORES_SHIELDS: Ramming damage IGNORES void shields (Core Rulebook p215) — no shield prompt.
SHIP_BOARDING.RAM_FACING_NOTE: Book p215: the ramming ship's bow must FACE the target at impact — a GM check (no spatial automation in v1).
SHIP_BOARDING.RAM_FAILED: The ram did not land — no damage (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.ROUT_CONTINUES: Equal or lower: the crew fights on — opposed Command tests again next Strategic Turn (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.ROUT_SURRENDER: The crew routes — the NPC vessel SURRENDERS to its captors (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_BOARDING.ROUT_GRIM_CHOICE: The crew routes — the explorers' vessel faces a grim choice—surrender to their foes, or try and flee as best they can... (Core Rulebook p215, GM decision).
SHIP_BOARDING.COMMAND_PROMPT: Who won the opposed Command Test — {ship} or {target}? (The test itself is resolved manually; the rows below are the printed bonuses.)
SHIP_BOARDING.DEGREES_PROMPT: By how many degrees did {winner} win the opposed Command Test?
SHIP_BOARDING.PICK_PROMPT: Per degree won ({degrees}): inflict crew damage (1d5 Crew Population + 1d5 Morale) or 1 point of Hull Integrity (Core Rulebook p215)?
SHIP_BOARDING.ROUT_RESOLVED_PROMPT: {ship}'s crew routed (the rout roll exceeded the current Morale). Whose vessel is it? (An NPC vessel surrenders; the explorers' vessel faces the grim choice.)
SHIP_BOARDING.ROUT_BRANCH_EXPLORERS: The explorers' vessel — the grim choice
SHIP_BOARDING.FLOW_CANCELLED: The boarding turn's prompts were cancelled before resolution — the rout flow stands UNRESOLVED with no damage applied (Core Rulebook p215). Repeat the Rout row to resolve it.
SHIP_ORDNANCE.BOARDED_NO_LAUNCH: No Manoeuvre or Shooting Actions while boarded — a torpedo launch rides the Shooting Action (Core Rulebook p215).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.NO_TUBES: The ship carries no intact torpedo-tube components (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.TRAVEL_COVER: A salvo attacks a vessel that passes within {cover} VU of its travel.
SHIP_ORDNANCE.NO_STORES: The ship holds no torpedo-store items — author ship-ordnance torpedo items on the ship to record its stores (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.NO_ACTIVE_RUNS: No active torpedo salvo is in flight — launch one with the Launch Torpedoes row first (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.DAMAGE_ROW: Bombing-run damage (summed hits minus the lowest armour)
SHIP_ORDNANCE.PICK_TUBE_PROMPT: The launch comes from one tube (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.PICK_TORPEDO_PROMPT: The salvo's warheads (Table 1-1, Battlefleet Koronus printed p8; the stores are the ship's own ship-ordnance torpedo items):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.PICK_SALVO_PROMPT: Resolve the movement + attack for one salvo this Strategic Turn (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.SALVO_PROMPT: How many torpedoes does {tube} launch? (No more than the tube's Strength and the stores — {maximum})
SHIP_ORDNANCE.WIDE_PROMPT: A 'wide salvo' spreads the spread: targets within 2 VUs are attacked, but the Ballistic Skill Test is Hard (-20) and at most half the salvo's current size can hit (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.GUIDANCE_PROMPT: The guidance system bought with these torpedoes (Battlefleet Koronus printed p9; Boarding torpedoes are always Guided and accept no other system):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.GUIDANCE_SHORT_BURN: Short-Burn Torpedoes (+{rating} Torpedo Rating; 15 VU/turn, range 30)
SHIP_ORDNANCE.LAUNCH_NOTE: No attack roll is needed at launch — the Torpedo Run row resolves the salvo's travel and its Ballistic Skill + Torpedo Rating test when it reaches its target (Battlefleet Koronus printed p6-7).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.TRAVEL_PROMPT: The salvo travels forward at the start of each of the parent ship's Strategic Turns ({salvo}: Speed {speed} VU/turn). Record this turn's travel (no more than {remaining} VU remain — Battlefleet Koronus printed p7):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.TRAVEL_COVERAGE: A salvo attacks a vessel that passes within {cover} VU of its travel.
SHIP_ORDNANCE.DISTANCE_PROMPT: Recorded distance between the salvo and {target} in VUs — a salvo strikes when it passes within 1 VU (2 for a wide salvo; Battlefleet Koronus printed p7; on a grid map the covered squares also count):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.TURRET_DOWN: Defensive turrets shot down {count} torpedo/torpedoes before the attack roll (Battlefleet Koronus printed p13; Core Rulebook p220: +5 per Turret Rating, 1 hit + 1 per two degrees).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.MELTA_FIRE: A Melta warhead's damage also causes a Fire! Critical Result (Battlefleet Koronus printed p9).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.BOARDING_HIT: A boarding torpedo wounded the hull — it lands a Hit-and-Run attack (Battlefleet Koronus printed p8).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.BOARDING_NOTE: Boarding torpedoes never wound Hull Integrity — each wound lands a Hit-and-Run attack instead (Battlefleet Koronus printed p8; Core Rulebook p218 machinery).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.SHIELDS_IGNORED: Torpedoes and attack craft are NOT stopped or hindered by void shields (Battlefleet Koronus printed pp7/13).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.NO_ATTACK_TURN: The salvo is out of range of any vessel this turn — no attack roll is made (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.RUN_SPENT: The salvo is spent: out of torpedoes or past its range — the reactors ran dry, the salvos shut down, cold and inactive.
SHIP_ORDNANCE.RELOAD_SKILL_PROMPT: The fast reload is a Difficult (-10) Command OR Tech-Use test (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7). Which skill rolls?
SHIP_ORDNANCE.RELOAD_NOTE: On a pass all empty launch tubes are loaded and may fire during the SAME Strategic Turn; without the action a full Strategic Turn reloads them (Battlefleet Koronus printed p7, manual bookkeeping in v1).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.CRAFT_PROMPT: The {craft} squadrons' Craft Rating (Battlefleet Koronus printed p15 — the abstract combat-effectiveness bonus):
SHIP_ORDNANCE.SQUADRONS_PROMPT: How many squadrons join the strike? (+5 per squadron beyond the first, Battlefleet Koronus printed pp13/11)
SHIP_ORDNANCE.SURVIVORS_PROMPT: How many assault-boat squadrons survived the defensive fire to attack? (Battlefleet Koronus printed p13 caps the landings at the survivors)
SHIP_ORDNANCE.LANDING_NOTE: {count} assault boat squadron(s) breached the hull — Hit and Run at +{bonus} (one per landed squadron, ignoring the Pilot test — Battlefleet Koronus printed p13; the Hit-and-Run row, Core Rulebook p218, runs it).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.HIT_AND_RUN_NOTE: The landed boarding parties run Hit and Run actions (Core Rulebook printed p218) — resolve those through the ship-action row.
SHIP_ORDNANCE.STRIKE_WITHDRAW: The squadrons withdraw to their carrier to refuel and rearm after the strike (Battlefleet Koronus printed pp12-13).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.ESCORT_NOTE: Escort squadrons give the turrets' Ballistic Skill Test -10 and take the defensive fire first (Battlefleet Koronus printed p12, manual note).
SHIP_ORDNANCE.FIGHTERS_PROMPT: Who won the opposed Challenging (+0) Command + Craft Rating Test — {ship} or {target}? (Battlefleet Koronus printed p12; the test itself is resolved manually.)
SHIP_ORDNANCE.SQUADRON_MANUAL_NOTE: One opposing squadron or torpedo is eliminated per degree (Battlefleet Koronus printed p12); enemy craft squadrons stay a manual note — the torpedo salvos are bookkept here.
STARSHIP.DROP_HINT: Drag ship-component / ship-weapon-component items here from the ships compendium to install them. Non-component items are refused with a warning.
STARSHIP.DROP_NOT_COMPONENT: "{name}" is not a ship component — not installed.
SHIP_CREATOR.TITLE: Ship Creator
SHIP_CREATOR.SP_BUDGET_HINT: The dynasty's rolled Ship Points (Table 1-5, Core Rulebook p33). Reads from the dynasty actor once that wiring lands (owner redesign); for now enter the rolled value here.
SHIP_CREATOR.CREW_HINT: Crew quality (Core Rulebook p193): all ships start Competent; Incompetent grants +5 SP, Crack costs 5 SP, Veteran 15 SP.
SHIP_CREATOR.NO_OPTIONS_FOR_HULL: No components of this type fit the chosen hull class.
SHIP_CREATOR.SLOT_HINT: One component per essential category (Core Rulebook p200); selecting replaces the previous pick.
SHIP_CREATOR.MISSING_ESSENTIALS: The ship is missing essential components: {list}. A ship must have one component from each category (Core Rulebook p200).
CHAT.QUALITY_WARP_WEAPON: Warp Weapon: damage doubles against targets with a Psy Rating, the Daemonic Trait, or any direct connection to the Warp.
CACHE.NO_TAKER: You have no assigned character, so there is nowhere to put anything you take.
CACHE.OVERLOADED: {actor} is now over capacity: {weight} kg carried of {capacity} kg ({count} item(s) taken).
ACTION.ROLL_UNKNOWN: Unknown action test “{test}” ({action}) — extend the roll mapping
ACTION.OPPOSED_MANUAL: Opposed test: the opposing side rolls their test manually.
PLANET.NAME: Name
PLANET.TABLES_HINT: Drag game-table rows from the Game Tables compendium to attach them to this planet.
PLANET_CREATOR.TITLE: Planet Creation
PLANET_CREATOR.NOT_DRAWN: Nothing drawn yet — roll to draw.
PLANET_CREATOR.NEED_INHABITANTS: Draw Inhabitants first — development is rolled per species.
PLANET_CREATOR.NO_ROWS: No game-table rows found for kind {kind}
PLANET_CREATOR.HINT_BODY: Table 1-6 (1d10). The drawn Body's modifiers to Gravity and Resources are printed in its prose — apply them with the stepper below.
PLANET_CREATOR.HINT_ORBITAL: Table 1-8 (1d10); re-roll further features on the drawn row's results.
PLANET_CREATOR.HINT_COMPOSITION: Table 1-10 (1d10; only with a breathable atmosphere — see the drawn row). Attached; compose the Atmosphere field manually if needed.
PLANET_CREATOR.HINT_CLIMATE: Table 1-11 (1d10 ± orbital/atmospheric modifiers from the drawn rows).
PLANET_CREATOR.HINT_TERRITORIES: Table 1-13 (1d5 ± size/ecosystem modifiers). Terrain, traits and resources roll per territory — roll those manually and drag-attach extra rows on the sheet.
PLANET_CREATOR.HINT_DEVELOPMENT: Table 1-27 (1d10, read against the species' row). Re-roll on uninhabitable worlds per the table.
PLANET.NO_PROFILE: No world profile yet — run the Planet Creation wizard (right-click the actor in the directory) or fill the fields below.
PLANET.NOTES_HINT: Free-text notes about this world — inhabitants' disposition, adventure hooks, resource notes.
RULES.MENU_HINT: Open the rules app to create, edit, activate and compare named house-rule profiles.
RULES.CORE_HINT: Core rules are the Core Rulebook as written — the base every profile is measured against.
RULES.CORE_READONLY: The Core Rulebook is read-only: create or duplicate a profile to change a rule.
RULES.INACTIVE_HINT: This profile is not the one in force — edits are stored, but nothing changes until you activate it.
RULES.PROFILE_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the profile "{name}"? Its house rules stop applying and the active rules fall back to the Core Rulebook. This cannot be undone.
RULES.PROFILE_SKIPPED_NOT_ROW: Stored profile entry {index} is not a profile row — it was skipped. Fix or delete it on the JSON tab.
RULES.PROFILE_SKIPPED_NO_ID: Stored profile entry {index} has no id — it was skipped. Fix or delete it on the JSON tab.
RULES.PROFILE_SKIPPED_NO_DELTA: Stored profile entry {index} has no delta — it was skipped. Fix or delete it on the JSON tab.
RULES.PROFILES_NOT_A_LIST: The stored profiles value is not a JSON array of profiles — nothing was read.
RULES.PACK_EXPORT_HINT: A rules pack is JSON another GM imports into their world. It carries the profiles you choose and the rules they were authored against, so a later Core Rulebook change can be spotted instead of quietly changing what a house rule means.
RULES.PACK_EXPORT_EMPTY: Core rules are in force — there is no profile to export. Create one, or choose "Every profile".
RULES.PACK_COPY_FAILED: Could not copy the pack to the clipboard: {message}
RULES.PACK_IMPORT_HINT: Paste a pack or pick a .json file. Nothing is imported until the WHOLE pack validates: a wrong kind, an unsupported schema version or an unknown knob is named and refused, never dropped.
RULES.PACK_IMPORT_ACTIVATE_HINT: One profile only: with several, the active profile stays as it is — pick the one you want in the list.
RULES.PACK_IMPORT_ACTIVATE_SKIPPED: The active profile was left as it was: this pack carries several profiles, so pick the one you want in the list.
RULES.PACK_IMPORTED_BASE_VERSION: The pack was authored against {profile} version {version}.
RULES.PACK_IMPORTED_NONE: The pack carries no profiles — nothing was imported.
RULES.PACK_OVERWRITE_CONFIRM: This pack replaces {names} — their current house rules are lost and the pack's versions are stored instead. Continue?
RULES.PACK_ERROR_NOT_JSON: The pack is not valid JSON: {message}
RULES.PACK_ERROR_NOT_AN_OBJECT: A rules pack must be a JSON object, got {got}.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_WRONG_KIND: This is not a Rogue Trader rules pack: kind is {got}, expected {expected}.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_SCHEMA_VERSION: Rules pack schema version {got} is not supported — this system reads version {supported}.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_PROFILES_NOT_LIST: The pack's "profiles" must be an array, got {got}.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_PROFILE_NOT_ROW: Pack profile {index} is not an object, got {got}.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_PROFILE_NO_ID: Pack profile {index} has no id — every profile needs one.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_PROFILE_BASE: Pack profile {index} ("{id}") has a "base" that is not an object of strings.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_PROFILE_NO_DELTA: Pack profile {index} ("{id}") has no delta — a profile needs the knob keys it changes.
RULES.PACK_ERROR_DUPLICATE_ID: The pack lists the id "{id}" twice (profile {index}) — each profile needs its own id.
RULES.CORE_VALUE_HINT: The Core Rulebook value for this rule.
RULES.DIFF_EMPTY: No house rules — this profile runs the Core Rulebook as written.
RULES.DIFF_BREAKING: BREAKING: a ledger-assuming house rule is in force. Every existing character's spent-xp ledger was built under the core value, so their recorded xp is wrong.
RULES.DIFF_HINT: Core vs effective: the effective column is the Core Rulebook with this profile's delta merged over it.
RULES.JSON_HINT: The stored delta: knob key to value. Saving validates it — an unknown key or a wrong-typed value is rejected and named, never dropped.
RULES.JSON_FORM_HINT: The Knobs tab writes the same delta for you.
RULES.TABLE_BAND_CONFLICT: Two rows use the same band — each band is one location. Fix or remove a row before saving.
RULES.TEST_CRIT_ON_DOUBLE_HINT: A successful test whose tens and units digits match is a Critical Hit.
RULES.TEST_AUTO_FAIL_ROLL_HINT: Rolls at or above this value always fail. The Core Rulebook prints no such band, so core is none.
RULES.TEST_AUTO_PASS_ROLL_HINT: Rolls at or below this value always succeed. Unused in the Core Rulebook, so core is none.
RULES.DAMAGE_PRIMITIVE_ARMOUR_DOUBLE_HIN: Non-primitive weapons deal double wounds against primitive armour.
RULES.DAMAGE_RIGHTEOUS_FURY_HINT: A natural 10 on the weapon's damage die (Core Rulebook pp249–250) triggers Righteous Fury: one extra damage die is rolled and added, looping while the new die shows a natural 10. Off suppresses the effect entirely.
RULES.COMBAT_FIRE_MODE_BONUS_BURST_HINT: The BS bonus a Semi-Auto Burst attack adds (Core Rulebook: +10).
RULES.COMBAT_FIRE_MODE_BONUS_FULL_HINT: The BS bonus a Full Auto Burst attack adds (Core Rulebook: +20).
RULES.PSYCHIC_PUSH_CAP_SANCTIONED_HINT: How far an Imperium-sanctioned psyker may Push a power (Table 6-1: +3).
RULES.PSYCHIC_PUSH_CAP_OTHER_HINT: The Push cap for a renegade or sorceror (Table 6-1: +4).
RULES.AMMO_AUTO_CONSUME_HINT: Firing a loaded launcher spends the loaded ordnance automatically. The Core Rulebook plays the manual -1 chip, so core is no.
RULES.SKILLS_UNTRAINED_SKILL_MODEL_HINT: How an untrained Basic Skill Test is resolved.
RULES.SKILLS_UNTRAINED_SKILL_PENALTY_HIN: The visible modifier the flat-penalty model applies. The Core Rulebook halves the governing Characteristic instead, so core carries no penalty — an empty field is correct, not a hole.
RULES.CREATION_CHARACTERISTIC_BASE_HINT: The base characteristic value before allocation. Creation only: it is read while a character is being created.
RULES.CREATION_POINT_BUY_BUDGET_HINT: The characteristic points a new character allocates. Creation only: existing characters are untouched.
RULES.CREATION_POINT_BUY_MAX_HINT: The highest value one characteristic may be raised to with points. Creation only.
RULES.CREATION_CREATOR_LAST_STEP_HINT: The character creator's final step index — wizard bookkeeping, not a printed number. Creation only.
RULES.ADVANCEMENT_PRE_SPENT_BASELINE_HIN: The xp every new character is assumed to have already spent (Core Rulebook: 4,500). Ledger assuming: every existing character's ledger was built under the core value.
RULES.ADVANCEMENT_ELITE_ADVANCE_BASE_COS: The base xp cost of a GM-granted Elite Advance (Core Rulebook: 500). Ledger assuming: existing ledgers were built under the core value.
RULES.TOXIC_PENALTY_PER_DAMAGE_POINT_HIN: The Toughness Test penalty per point of Damage taken from a Toxic hit (Core Rulebook: 5).
RULES.CRITICALS_MAX_SEVERITY_HINT: The highest Critical Damage severity the critical effects run to (the Core Rulebook critical tables print ten results).
RULES.BATTLESUIT_REPAIR_TEST_MODIFIER_HI: The modifier on the Tech-Use or Trade (Armourer) Test that removes a Battlesuit Critical Effect (Tau Character Guide: Hard, -20).
RULES.TABLES_HIT_LOCATIONS_HINT: Whole replacement: Core Rulebook Table 9-6, Hit Locations, keyed on the REVERSED to-hit roll. A band you leave out falls back to Body.
ROLL.HOUSE_RULES_HINT: Open the rules app to see or change the active house rules.
RULES.MODULE_HINT: Registered by a module at its own init. A module's rules apply on top of the active profile — where both set the same knob, the active profile wins. Activate one to run its rules on their own.
RULES.MODULE_READONLY: This profile ships with a module, so it is read-only: activate it to put its rules in force, or copy them into a profile of your own.
RULES.DH.TEST_AUTOMATIC_FAILURE_ROLL_HIN: A roll at or above this value always fails (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p22: 100). The book prints the band, so core is never empty.
RULES.DH.TEST_AUTOMATIC_SUCCESS_ROLL_HIN: A roll at or below this value always succeeds (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p22: 1) — a single digit, not a wider band.
RULES.DH.DAMAGE_DEGREES_REPLACE_ONE_DIE: Degrees of success replace one damage die
RULES.DH.DAMAGE_DEGREES_REPLACE_ONE_DIE_: On a successful attack the attacker may replace the result on ONE damage die with the attack's degrees of success (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p227). Rogue Trader has no equivalent rule.
RULES.DH.COMBAT_STANDARD_ATTACK_BONUS_HI: The modifier a Standard Attack adds to the attack test, melee or ranged (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p226: +10). DH2e signs its fire modes, so this is not Rogue Trader's Semi-Auto Burst bonus.
RULES.DH.COMBAT_FULL_AUTO_BURST_PENALTY_: The Ballistic Skill penalty a Full Auto Burst imposes on the attacker (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p226: -10).
RULES.DH.COMBAT_SEMI_AUTO_BURST_MODIFIER: The Ballistic Skill modifier a Semi-Auto Burst carries (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p223: Challenging, +0; it jams on 94+). There is no single-shot action — a single shot is the Standard Attack.
RULES.DH.PSYCHIC_PUSH_CAP_BOUND_HINT: How far a Bound psyker may set a power's effective psy rating above his own (Table 6-1, DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p195: +2).
RULES.DH.PSYCHIC_PUSH_CAP_DAEMONIC_HINT: How far a Daemonic psyker may set a power's effective psy rating above his own (Table 6-1, DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p195: +3).
RULES.DH.PSYCHIC_PUSH_CAP_UNBOUND_HINT: How far an Unbound psyker may set a power's effective psy rating above his own (Table 6-1, DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p195: +4).
RULES.DH.CREATION_GENERATION_DICE_HINT: How many d10s each characteristic roll uses at creation (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p31: 2). Creation only: existing characters keep the values they rolled.
RULES.DH.CREATION_GENERATION_BONUS_HINT: The number added to each characteristic roll at creation (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p31: +20). Creation only.
RULES.DH.CREATION_XP_BUDGET_HINT: The experience points a new character has to SPEND at creation (DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p78: 1,000, none pre-spent). Creation only.
RULES.DH.ADVANCEMENT_CHARACTERISTIC_COST: Simple advance cost (two aptitudes)

The xp cost of a Simple characteristic advance when the character shares two aptitudes with it (Table 2-2, DH2 Core Rulebook, printed p80: 100). Ledger assuming: every existing character's spent-xp ledger was built under the core value.
